visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A sepia-toned, sketch-like illustration depicting an interior room with a sloped ceiling. A man is sitting on the floor with his head in his hands, appearing distressed. Another man is lying unconscious on the floor in the foreground. Strange, tentacled, bulbous organic forms are present in the room, one near the unconscious man and another on the right side. A tall, thin, tripod-like structure stands in the background.
